h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Itanagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Itanagar

items.pText: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, spread over forested hills in the foothills of the eastern Himalaya. Government offices, schools and residential colonies here need play areas, and almost every site sits on sloping ground. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,280 km away, and sends it to Arunachal Pradesh by road.

Visitors from other states need an Inner Line Permit to enter Arunachal Pradesh, and that includes our installation crew. We plan for the permit when we schedule your installation, so keep some time for it in your project plan. The last part of the road climbs through the hills, which limits how large a structure can reach your site. Tell us about the approach road, and we will suggest equipment that can be carried up and assembled on site.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Send us photos of the approach as well as the site itself. Where trucks cannot reach the gate, individual pieces and compact play stations are easier to carry in than a large tower. Itanagar gets heavy rain for much of the year, so the level platform for the play area needs firm edges and a drain along its uphill side. Grouted foundations hold better than self-standing bases on soft, wet hill soil. Government buyers can share the layout with their engineers before work starts.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 2,280 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Does your installation team need a permit for Arunachal Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. Visitors from outside the state need an Inner Line Permit, and that applies to our crew as well. We plan for it when scheduling your installation.

items.q: Can large play structures be taken to hill sites in Itanagar?
items.a: It depends on the approach road. Where access is narrow or steep, we suggest individual pieces and compact play stations that can be carried in and assembled on site.

items.q: Who installs playground equipment in Arunachal Pradesh?
items.a: Our installation team or a dealer who serves the Northeast. The equipment is made in Vasai and sent by road, then installed according to the layout drawing you approve.
